content: Customers may request a refund within 7 days of delivery when the order satisfies the refund conditions.
Standard domestic shipping usually arrives within three to five business days after fulfillment.
Account recovery requires identity verification and a one-time code sent to a previously verified channel.
Priority incidents are triaged immediately and routed to the on-call support owner with an explicit severity.
Personal data is processed only for approved purposes and is retained according to the documented retention schedule.
